verdict.rationale: There's evidence of a built-in "Ask Rippling AI" assistant that can answer questions, surface answers, and automate remediations/reports (rippling-it-docs-24, rippling-it-docs-32, rippling-it-docs-12), which supports delegating tasks to an in-product AI assistant. However, evidence is thin marketing-style claims without depth on scope, task variety, or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of assistant capabilities/limits, concrete examples of multi-step task delegation, independent/hands-on verification of the assistant actually completing delegated tasks.
